LanguageData.VTE_RestSlowFallFactor.label: insomnia
LanguageData.VTE_RestSlowFallFactor.description: Persistent unrest prevents deep sleep. The body demands rest less often, but prolonged waking leaves movement and work impaired.
LanguageData.VTE_SlowerBleedingRate.label: rapid clotting
LanguageData.VTE_SlowerBleedingRate.description: Unusually rapid coagulation causes open wounds to bleed at roughly half the normal rate.
LanguageData.VTE_HigherBleedingRate.label: hemophilia
LanguageData.VTE_HigherBleedingRate.description: Impaired coagulation causes open wounds to bleed much more heavily than normal.
